matches.title: Tertiary Minerals MD on deeper drilling and maiden Mushima North resource plans
matches.description: Tertiary Minerals PLC (AIM:TYM, OTC:TTIRF, FRA:TMU) managing director Richard Belcher talked with Proactive's Stephen Gunnion about encouraging Phase 4 drilling results at its Mushima North project in Zambia, the start of deeper drilling and plans for a maiden mineral resource before year-end. The latest results confirmed wide, near-surface silver, copper and zinc intersections at the Discovery Zone, with mineralisation extending beyond the existing exploration target. Several holes also ended in mineralisation, suggesting further potential at depth. Phase 5 diamond drilling is now underway, targeting depths of up to 200 metres to test beneath the oxide zone and investigate the potential for primary sulphide mineralisation. Beyond the Discovery Zone, Tertiary is exploring further opportunities at the Western Zone and other nearby targets, with additional exploration planned for next year. The focus now is on establishing the scale, depth and economic potential of Mushima North as the company advances towards its first mineral resource.
